title: Derived sections unit followed by Leray on a representative
statement: For t:Y→S_s^sh, any complex D of abelian sheaves on Y, a bounded-below derived object T and any r:Q(D)→T, exact strict-local sections of the direct-image unit, transported to the bounded-below derived functor and followed by Leray, equal Q of the underived direct-image/global-sections comparison followed by the derived global-sections unit at D and transport by r. Neither acyclicity of D nor invertibility of r is assumed.

proof.text:
expand the exact sections comparison and the bounded-below/unbounded
right-derived compatibility. Their defining unit compatibilities identify their
composite with the inverse exact-to-right-derived sections comparison.
Naturality moves the map from Q(D) to T through the Leray isomorphism. Expand
Leray as the inverse derived composition isomorphism followed by the derived
underived sections isomorphism. The composition unit factorization now gives
the sections unit at D preceded by the localized underived sections isomorphism.
Naturality of the sections unit and quotient/localization isomorphisms accounts
for the displayed transport r. This calculation never inverts the direct-image
unit or the sections unit at D; it holds for zero and nonacyclic complexes. The exactness input is strictHenselization_globalSections_preservesFiniteColimits. The other steps use the proved generic source interfaces Functor.rightDerived_ext, rightDerivedNatTrans_fac, rightDerivedFunctorPlusIsoMapDerivedCategoryPlus_hom_fac, rightDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory_hom_fac and the definition of rightDerivedLowerStarCompRightDerivedGlobalSectionsIso, not derivedLeray_comp.

Use the general pointed-section-cone restriction on strictLocalSectionCone, the existing exact-sections instance for the small colimit model, and the general exact-global-sections Leray comparison wherever the former specialized restriction API was used. The cone restriction has the same section formulas, its germ predicate is definitionally identical, and uniqueness identifies the chosen stalk maps. All other argument steps and all scheme models stay as before.
